# rcn3rdparty/bootstrap-datepicker-dist

> 标签: bootstrap, datepicker

## 简介

A datepicker for Bootstrap, distribution version without hideous dependencies

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 5；已收录于 php-v5, php-v7, php-v8。

## 官网

- 官网：https://packagist.org/packages/rcn3rdparty%2Fbootstrap-datepicker-dist
- 源码仓库：https://github.com/RCNdev/bootstrap-datepicker-dist.git
- Packagist 页面：https://packagist.org/packages/rcn3rdparty%2Fbootstrap-datepicker-dist

- v1.7.1

## 获取地址

- Composer 安装：`composer require rcn3rdparty/bootstrap-datepicker-dist`
- Packagist 仓库：https://repo.packagist.org/p2/rcn3rdparty/bootstrap-datepicker-dist.json
